name: Harvest Valley Farms
description: In 917 Deer Creek Road, PA, Harvest Valley Farms raises Apples, Pumpkins, Corn, Peppers, and Honey on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
